verdict.rationale: Casium's own pages describe an attorney-of-record model. It calls itself "a licensed law firm, technology platform, and service partner in one" and says "Licensed attorneys review and sign every filing" and "Best-in-class attorneys file your visas." Each client gets a dedicated attorney and case team they can message directly, which rules out an unsupervised form service. Missing for 10: named attorneys or bar admissions on the provider's pages, details of who signs as attorney of record (e.g., G-28 practice), and independent or hands-on corroboration that licensed lawyers actually prepare and file petitions.
